subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- October 17, 2026
body:
**AcreetionOS Newsletter - October 17, 2026**

**GNOME OS Preview: A New Era for Linux**

We're excited to share the news that the GNOME Project has released a preview of GNOME OS, a new operating system built on top of the GNOME desktop environment. This marks a significant milestone in the evolution of Linux, offering a fresh take on the traditional desktop experience. As a community-driven project, AcreetionOS is always looking for innovative ways to improve our users' experience. We'll be keeping a close eye on GNOME OS and exploring ways to integrate its features into our own distribution.

**Community News**

* The results of the 2026 TAB election have been announced, with several new members joining the Linux Foundation Technical Advisory Board.
* Our community has been actively engaged in discussions on our Discord server, with many users sharing their thoughts on the latest developments in the Linux world.

**Practical Tip**

Did you know that you can easily update your AcreetionOS system using the `sudo pacman -Syu` command? This command will update all packages to the latest version, ensuring you have the latest security patches and features. Simply open a terminal and type the command to get started!

That's all for this week's newsletter. Stay tuned for more updates from the AcreetionOS community!

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva
Co-Lead Developer, AcreetionOS
